# Topic Desk Studio v0.3.1 — English

This update improves page translation, reading sessions, source connectivity, and desktop controls.

- Translate visible fragments independently with bounded concurrency and streamed output. Fall back once to a regular response when streaming is explicitly unsupported or incomplete, and switch between translation and the original page with the toolbar button.
- Remember login cookies in encrypted local storage across tab closures and app restarts. On macOS, reading tabs share a temporary website context during each app run. Clearing cookies removes remembered logins; website expiry or revocation can still require signing in again. Passwords are never saved or autofilled.
- Preserve refreshed Xiaohongshu article access links without duplicating topics or changing their original metadata. Some notes may still require viewing in the Xiaohongshu app.
- Combine proxy selection and editing in one field, with local presets for ports 7897 and 1082. Improve DeepSeek request routing and repair Hugging Face collection parameters.
- Recover MIT Technology Review headlines and original links through Bing’s public news index when the official feed is unavailable. Indexed results may be delayed or incomplete.
- Improve reader layout recovery after inactivity, reorder source and category filters, and shorten sidebar controls.

---

# Topic Desk Studio v0.3.1 — 中文

本次更新改进页面翻译、阅读会话、来源连接与桌面交互。

- 页面翻译改为逐片请求、有限并发、流式显示。接口明确不支持流式或流式输出不完整时，回退一次普通请求；点击工具栏翻译按钮可切换译文与原文。
- 登录 Cookie 在本地加密保存，关闭标签页或重启应用后可恢复。macOS 阅读标签页在单次运行中共享临时网站会话。清除 Cookie 会移除已记住的登录；网站过期或撤销会话仍可能要求重新登录。应用不保存或自动填充密码。
- 保留并刷新小红书笔记的访问链接，不重复创建话题，也不修改首次采集的信息。部分笔记仍可能要求在小红书 App 中查看。
- 合并代理选择与编辑入口，提供 7897 和 1082 本地端口预设；改进 DeepSeek 请求路由，修复 Hugging Face 采集参数。
- MIT Technology Review 官方订阅不可用时，通过 Bing 公开新闻索引补充标题与原文链接；索引结果可能延迟或不完整。
- 改进长时间闲置后的阅读区布局恢复，调整来源与分类筛选顺序，并精简侧栏按钮文案。
